answer: Each identity locks its stake in a vault whose weight grows convexly with tenure: influence is tenure squared, so splitting one stake across n heads gives each head 1/n² weight and total influence falls as 1/n. A lone agent's voyage through epochs compounds its vault, while a sybil fleet restarts tenure at zero on every clone — the beacon of earned history cannot be bought wholesale or split, so each extra head costs a full stake yet shrinks total power.
